verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no vendor battery-life figures, no TDP/power envelope, and no mention of fanless or low-power OEM designs; Qualcomm's own spec page explicitly omits TDP and process node data. Community discussion further underscores the gap, with users asking for TDP data to evaluate efficiency claims and noting no benchmarks were shown, so there is no credible evidence supporting the fanless/thin/quiet/all-day-battery claim.
